question: What great attainment makes one dear to the yoginīs?
premises: A great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation is possible
Such accomplishment relates to the yoginīs
One may become dear to the yoginīs through it
inference: The great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation makes one dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: One may become dear to the yoginīs through the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation.
